scope: all implemented research catalogue entries at generation
principle: Specialize measured performance choices by complete workload contract; keep semantic legality, dependencies and validation unconditional.

features.title: Recovered arithmetic instruction sequences and rounding policy
features.applicability: Exact PTX opcode/modifiers, operand types/forms and supported SM80 encodings; independent of tensor M/N/K.
features.current_selection: Legal instruction fragments are selected from the actual PTX operation, not a shape lookup.
features.next_action: Search equivalent forms under semantic/encoding/hardware gates; do not make correct arithmetic contingent on a shape win.
features.catalogue_summary: The standard backend imports retained CUDA 12.8 arithmetic fragments and generates its own words.

features.title: Constant integer division and remainder lowering
features.applicability: 32-bit signed/unsigned constant divisor and exact quotient/remainder semantics; runtime dividends retain proved domain.
features.current_selection: Divisor- and signedness-specific lowering already chooses shifts/magic-multiply sequences.
features.next_action: Preserve exhaustive/proof checks. Tune alternative legal forms by instruction use, not by unrelated GEMM dimensions.
features.catalogue_summary: The implemented 32-bit lowering removes a reciprocal-based path from direct PTX division/remainder sites.

features.title: Cooperative population LayerNorm
features.applicability: Contiguous FP32 rows, width1..1024, positive normal finite FP32 epsilon; y-only population LayerNorm, no affine/saved statistics/backward.
features.current_selection: Explicit rowwise command; one warp per row, four warps per CTA fixed. No native graph substitution.
features.next_action: Run rowwise1/2/4/8-warp campaign on unchanged five-pattern gates; integrate only current exact shape winners.
features.catalogue_summary: Shifted population LayerNorm passes full finite-domain tests; affine, saved statistics and backward are absent.

features.title: Cooperative FP32 row softmax
features.applicability: Contiguous bounded finite FP32 rows, width1..1024; full-warp max/sum reductions, no mask/backward.
features.current_selection: Explicit rowwise command with fixed four warps per CTA; tails are semantic masks, not optional tuning.
features.next_action: Run rowwise1/2/4/8-warp campaign and record shape-specific winners and regressions before promotion.
features.catalogue_summary: Native warp-per-row softmax passes the full five-pattern contract; large serial-mapping gains, ptxas still faster.

features.title: Loadable cubins and metadata-safe code replacement
features.applicability: Exact kernel entry/ABI, generated text, register declaration, exit offsets and container metadata.
features.current_selection: Always required when publishing native cubins.
features.next_action: Keep binary/resource identity checks mandatory for every tuned candidate; do not shape-gate metadata repair.
features.catalogue_summary: The production container code parses/serializes CUDA ELF and .nv.info records, replaces kernel text, fixes exit offsets and declares the generated register count.

features.title: CUDA C/C++ frontend through nvcc PTX
features.applicability: Supported CUDA/C++ device kernel syntax and nvcc PTX output; native OA handles supported PTX backend forms.
features.current_selection: Source language/repository configuration, not matrix geometry, chooses the frontend.
tuning_axes: nvcc options affecting exact numerical contract
features.next_action: Retain separate native and explicit ptxas fallback labels. No shape-only promise about arbitrary C++ applications.
features.catalogue_summary: nvcc supplies CUDA parsing/PTX, while OpenAssembler supplies supported native SASS generation.

features.title: CUTLASS-style load-next / compute-current fragment schedule
features.applicability: 128tile stagepair m_fast, legacy late pointers, unfused;1024x4096x1024 and4096x1024x1024 FP16/BF16 only.
features.current_selection: Explicit fragment_schedule=load_next and an admitted GEMM tuning candidate; no universal auto row.
features.next_action: Current production GEMM campaign compares it against direct/early and geometry choices; promote exact wins, retain large-shape regressions.
features.catalogue_summary: Explicit load_next fragment scheduling is integrated for two exact wide FP16/BF16 shapes; full gates pass and the default source-order schedule remains unchanged.

features.title: Dead-code removal, copy coalescing and local folding
features.applicability: Actual use/def, aliases, predicates, implicit vector readers and side effects; independent of application shape when proof holds.
features.current_selection: Regular scalar/tensor pipeline before allocation.
features.next_action: Preserve mandatory alias/guard/implicit-reader correctness; benchmark broader rewrites by kernel identity rather than disabling valid DCE by shape.
features.catalogue_summary: These passes are in the regular scalar and tensor compilation pipelines before allocation.

features.title: Direct pointer homes for asynchronous GEMM copies
features.applicability: Aligned loop-carried64bit pointer homes; explicit stagepair m_fast unfused contract; no altered address WAR.
features.current_selection: Manual pointer_mode=direct; GEMM tuner tests legal shapes. One current exact tile64/direct automatic row at audit start.
features.next_action: Revalidate all historical shapes through source-inclusive CLI and retain exact source/cubin/SASS before automatic routing.
features.catalogue_summary: Explicit mode improves tested MLP products but regresses on tall GEMM; legacy remains the default.

features.title: Earlier pointer advancement in tensor mainloops
features.applicability: 128tile stagepair m_fast unfused GEMM; early update preserves LDGSTS address-WAR and copy visibility dependencies.
features.current_selection: Explicit late/early and narrow pointer_advance=auto for1024x4096x1024; global GEMM tuner compares legal policies.
features.next_action: Select exact repeated wins against all current controls; keep tall regressions and no shortening of dependency waits.
features.catalogue_summary: Integrated as explicit early/late/shape-specific auto policy; early helps the measured wide shape and regresses tall controls, so auto remains narrow.

features.title: Fused Adam-like scalar update example
features.applicability: FP32 example returns out/mn/vn; no bias correction, step policy or decoupled weight decay. Not AdamW.
features.current_selection: Explicit example kernel only; not substituted into training optimizers.
features.next_action: May tune the exact formula by size; a complete optimizer needs full mutable-state and precision-contract validation first.
features.catalogue_summary: Fused example passes tolerance and beats the chosen eager expression; it is not complete AdamW or a tuned-optimizer comparison.

features.title: Fused FP32 bias, residual and ReLU epilogues
features.applicability: 128tile stagepair GEMM, FP32 ((matmul+Bias)+Residual), optional finite ReLU; extra ABI buffers and grouping are part of semantics.
features.current_selection: Explicit bias_residual/bias_residual_relu plan; unfused GEMM tuner rejects this different contract.
features.next_action: Add a separate fused-contract tuner and whole-boundary comparison; never rank against bare GEMM as if equal work.
features.catalogue_summary: The explicit `bias_residual` and `bias_residual_relu` plans compute `(A@B.T + Bias) + Residual`, then optional finite-value ReLU, with FP32 inputs to the epilogue and FP32 output.

features.title: GPU execution, explicit launch specifications and fault isolation
features.applicability: Exact buffers, layouts, argument ABI, block/grid/shared bytes and selected cubin; faults isolated by worker.
features.current_selection: Checked source contract or explicit launch spec; no guessed scalar launch for unannotated tensor kernels.
features.next_action: Every tuned shape must retain its correct launch. Execution safety and validation stay mandatory regardless of speed.
features.catalogue_summary: Typed launch planning, fault-isolated local/Modal/SSH transports implemented; Modal hardware is validated and latest real SSH evidence is absent.

features.title: CUTLASS-style grouped-N CTA traversal
features.applicability: 128tile stagepair legacy/late unfused; Ntile count divisible8; exact transformed grid(Mtiles*8,Ntiles/8).
features.current_selection: Explicit grouped_n8; available in current GEMM candidate set; held-out tall evidence exists, no global default.
features.next_action: Revalidate tall controls as well as forward roles; preserve mfast/Morton alternatives for shapes where groupedN loses.
features.catalogue_summary: Explicit grouped_n8 CTA traversal is integrated with a checked launch grid; current A100 held-out FP16/BF16 tall cases pass while wide/square auto-dispatch remains disabled.

features.title: Four-way counted-loop unrolling
features.applicability: Supported counted-loop form, trip count/remainder/control and register pressure; tensor path bypasses scalar unroller.
features.current_selection: Scalar opt applies factor4; safe/sched do not apply the same unroll sequence.
features.next_action: Create scalar safe/sched/opt/factor search using exact workload/launch specs. A GEMM M/N/K lookup cannot tune arbitrary scalar loops.
features.catalogue_summary: The `opt` scalar path applies four-way unrolling to the supported counted-loop form.

features.title: Exact AlphaTensor/Strassen factors and FP32 research plans
features.applicability: Explicit FP32 low-rank/factor research plans; exact factors and temporary transforms; not the dense FP16/BF16 tensor contract.
features.current_selection: User-selected research path only.
features.next_action: Bound live products and match precision before comparing. Do not silently replace ordered HMMA GEMM with different numerical semantics.
features.catalogue_summary: Exact factors and explicit FP32 research plans exist; sampled/interrupted timing records do not prove a general win.

features.title: Morton8 logical CTA traversal
features.applicability: Complete8x8 groups of128-outputtiles; changes CTA traversal, not MMA fragment storage layout.
features.current_selection: Explicit morton8 and legal GEMM tuner candidate.
features.next_action: Current campaign includes prior tall winners and broad role negatives; promote repeated exact wins only.
features.catalogue_summary: Corrected 8×8 tile traversal helps tested tall grids; it is not an MMA storage layout or automatic policy.

features.title: Native tanh-approximation GELU example
features.applicability: FP32 tanh-approximate forward GELU with declared FP64 tolerance; not exact-erf GELU and not bitwise library equality.
features.current_selection: Standalone explicit example; no native graph replacement.
features.next_action: Tune launch/source variants per size under the same approximation/gate; integrate graph path separately.
features.catalogue_summary: Tanh-GELU passes a predeclared FP64 tolerance, while the old exact gate failure remains and gains depend on size.

features.title: Native scalar ReLU example
features.applicability: Finite FP32 elementwise ReLU; operation semantics and tails must remain fixed.
features.current_selection: Standalone explicit example; no automatic library substitution.
features.next_action: Tune small launch-bound and large bandwidth-bound cases separately; retain PyTorch/same-PTX controls and all tails.
features.catalogue_summary: Finite-input exact example passes; measured large-size PyTorch is faster, with no universal speedup.

features.title: Native SM80 tensor GEMM compiler and mainloop
features.applicability: Unbatched aligned contiguousRCR FP16/BF16 inputs, FP32acc/output, alpha1 beta0, full64/128M/Ntiles,K%128; contract excludes general layouts/tails.
features.current_selection: Native CLI exact measured dispatch plus optionalGPUtuning; unknown/stale rows baseline.
features.next_action: Current source-inclusive selection/held-out campaign retests all admitted alternatives and preserves exact negative controls.
features.catalogue_summary: The production `gemm` path computes C=A@B.T with contiguous FP16/BF16 operands, FP32 accumulation/output, 128×128×64 CTA tiles, four 64×64 warp tiles, 128 threads and 64 KiB dynamic shared memory.

features.title: Operand reuse hints and ordering
features.applicability: Supported neighboring HMMA operand identities; unchanged live fragments and implicit readers; not a programmable register cache.
features.current_selection: TensorConfig.reuse=True in production; no arbitrary mask CLI switch.
features.next_action: Future joint fragment/reuse search needs exact words and hardware/counters; never overwrite live inputs to gain a hint.
features.catalogue_summary: The tensor scheduler emits reuse hints for supported neighboring HMMA operands.

features.title: Paired B-fragment LDSM loads and register-group use
features.applicability: Validated lane map and aligned LDSM.x4 B half-pairs; both halves remain explicit register readers.
features.current_selection: Selected generator uses paired loads; tile family determines counts.
features.next_action: Compare complete source families jointly with registers/layouts; the legal native-half pair rule remains a correctness invariant.
features.catalogue_summary: The selected native kernel uses paired `LDSM.x4` B loads.

features.title: Native PTX input and compilation boundary
features.applicability: Implemented PTX opcode/type/control subset and exact supportedSM80 architecture; unsupported forms refuse or explicitfallback.
features.current_selection: Inputlanguage/IRcontent chooses native scalar or tensor backend.
features.next_action: Keep semantics and explicit unsupported boundaries; performance dispatch occurs after contract recognition.
features.catalogue_summary: Supported SM80 PTX routes to the native scalar/tensor backends with explicit verification limits.

features.title: Typed Python kernel frontend
features.applicability: Typed numeric @kernel subset, fixedGPUinteger/floatsemantics and safe AST parsing; no arbitrary hostPython compilation.
features.current_selection: Source annotations/types and supported constructs, not shape labels.
features.next_action: Specialize declared constants safely; native GPU execution is SASS, so host-language rewriting is not a tensor throughput policy.
features.catalogue_summary: Typed numeric Python source compiles without executing imports; fixed GPU numeric semantics are explicit.

features.title: PyTorch application capture and saved replay
features.applicability: Configured arguments/observed shapes/branches and exact state/runtime; Inductor/Triton own GPU code in this route.
features.current_selection: Explicit configured application frontend; cache replay forbids uncapturedspecializations.
features.next_action: Native kernel tuning does not automatically affect ordinaryPyTorch. Add controllednativegraphhook and first-divergence/fullstate gate before application speed claims.
features.catalogue_summary: Actual verified capture/replay passes77 tensors and cache-only replay; lowering is Inductor/Triton, not native OA.

features.title: Repository discovery, manifests and safe artifact publication
features.applicability: Safe source discovery, naming/dependency context, atomic output,manifest publication andboundedparallelCPUbuilds.
features.current_selection: Repository/input context; compileworker count is host-resource choice.
features.next_action: Measure compile/startup separately; hostbuildconcurrency does not select fastest GPU kernel by shape.
features.catalogue_summary: Safe discovery, path mirroring, manifests, locking and publication are implemented and tested.

features.title: SASS execution emulator and fitted tensor arithmetic

features.current_selection: Explicit validation and regression coverage, not runtime throughputdispatch.
